Draw your sound.

Draw freely on the canvas. Horizontal position sets when a note plays. Higher marks make higher notes.

Each color plays its own instrument: Keys, Pluck, Bell, Marimba, Flute, Strings, Chime, Bass, or 8-bit. Overlapping lines make chords. Each stroke keeps its instrument.

The dot buttons add Bass, Drums, and Arpeggio. Turn them on separately or together. Their colored dots show the rhythm below your drawing. They follow the key and tempo and are included in exports.

Use Erase to cut a line, or Undo to go back. Timing changes the rhythm without changing your drawing. Guides show the notes in the current scale.

Add loop creates another picture. Duplicate and the arrows build your sequence. Turn on Song mode and press Play to hear all loops in order. At 120 BPM, an eight-beat loop lasts four seconds. Save song keeps all editable pictures and backing parts in a file. WAV exports audio. MIDI exports notes and instrument channels. Your work stays in this tab until you save it.

Keyboard: P for pen, E for erase, space for playback, Ctrl/Cmd Z for undo. Focus the canvas and use arrows to move, Enter to place a note, or Shift plus arrows to draw.
